Camera tracking

Tracks your face (or your body in Body mode) with your camera, inside this browser tab. No video is uploaded. Keep the camera still and sit alone in view.

Connect to Twitch chat without login

Reads a public channel's chat anonymously (read-only). No account, token or Twitch application is needed. Chat commands such as !drop 2 or !pie 1 send a ball or a pie. Anonymous reading is not documented by Twitch; use it on your own channel or one whose owner agreed.

03 / THE RULES

Ready to play?

Give chat a button.
Give the streamer half a second.

01Chat shoots

Type !drop 1 to !drop 3 to send a ball (middle lane = two-pointer, 2 points; left and right lanes = three-pointers, 3 points) or !pie 1 to !pie 3 to throw a pie.

02Catch the balls, dodge the pies

Lean to put the hoop under the ball; without a camera, click the arena or use the arrow keys. A pie flashes its lane first, then appears: step out of that lane.

03Finish the 75 s round

A ball scores 2 or 3 points; the closer the hoop is to its middle the better the judgement (PERFECT +1, GREAT, GOOD −1), and a streak of catches adds a bonus (+1 per 5 in a row, up to +3). A caught pie costs 2 points and a missed ball ends the streak; a dodged pie scores nothing. Grades depend on the level you picked (NORMAL: S 130, A 95, B 60). Press Restart to play again.
